fusions.name: Falling Grey
fusions.desc: A drop from above that deals 8 damage, up to 1.6 times that at maximum range, and leaves the target [Soaked] for 5 seconds. It costs 4% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Storm Front
fusions.desc: Beats a gale of rain ahead of you, dealing 26 damage to everything in the cone. Every hit is a critical hit, and the target has a 60% chance of [Slowed] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Shelter from Storm
fusions.desc: Restores 14 health to you and every ally within 3.5 tiles. Your movement speed rises 20% for 5 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Damp Feathers
fusions.desc: When you are hurt by something other than fire, you gain a ward that absorbs 20% of your maximum health for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
